rasterize_meshes_with_rasterizer: build a python module to rasterize a batch of 3D meshes using MeshRasterizer with cameras and RasterizationSettings
create_rasterization_settings: create a RasterizationSettings dataclass to configure image size, blur radius, and faces per pixel for mesh rasterization
transform_meshes_to_ndc: build a python module to transform world-space mesh vertices into NDC space using MeshRasterizer transform method
detach_fragments_from_graph: create a function to detach Fragments rasterization output from the computational graph to stop gradient flow
review_fragments_dataclass: review the Fragments dataclass members pix_to_face, zbuf, bary_coords, and dists for rasterization output
